description: This file defines the LocationService class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class implements interfaces related to location and internet status, providing methods for querying location info such as country, region, city, and network type. It also manages network probe and state transitions, and handles web requests/responses for location services.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: Implements location and internet interface methods, manages network state, and handles web communication for location data.

methods.name: PublicIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the current public IP address.

methods.name: NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the current network type (IPv4, IPv6, or Unknown).

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Handles partial request reception, attaches the body.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Handles asynchronous dispatching of location service tasks.

methods.name: Probe
methods.description: Probes a remote node with retries and timeout.
